'''Qade''' was a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] on the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] between the Galactic Alliance and the [[Confederation]].<ref name="Invincible" /> By [[41 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]'' to [[41 ABY]].</ref> he had achieved the [[Police rank|rank]] of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]],<ref name="Invincible" /> and was also part of its [[Galactic Alliance Guard]].<ref name="CSWE" /> During that time, he had earned a reputation as an honest [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who always demanded a full report on events from his subordinates.<ref name="Invincible" />

While attempting to rescue [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ben Skywalker]] from a Galactic Alliance Guard operation in<ref name="Invincible" /> 41 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] was stopped by CSF Officers [[Tobyl]] and [[Jat'ho]]. She convinced them to let her pass using a combination of a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] and a cover story pretending to investigate Qade. The two officers believed her and she was able to commandeer the [[Medical speeder|medwagon]] the officers had been guarding and pursue the [[Doomsled|vehicle]] carrying Skywalker.<ref name="Invincible" />

==Behind the scenes==
Qade was first mentioned in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]'' by [[Troy Denning]], a [[2008]] novel released as part of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series.<ref name="Invincible" />
